Optional insert for D8 (not in footage.ts): live passkey sign-in up to where it works: 'Continue with passkey' -> 'Create a passkey account' -> header 'Passkey account 0x2ff…F90c'.

Virtual authenticator limited to ES256 by an init script: Chromium's virtual authenticator otherwise picks Ed25519 (alg -8, listed first in ZeroDev's options), which the Kernel WebAuthn validator cannot use; the app then shows 'The passkey account could not be opened.' after a WebCrypto DataError.

No transaction possible: rpc.zerodev.app (bundler and paymaster) returns HTTP 403 'Access denied: Neither IP nor domain is on the allowlist.' for zd_getUserOperationGasPrice; the wallet menu says 'Gas sponsorship isn't on; this account needs a little testnet ETH.'
